data.title: 椎叶紬 · 相册里的一页
data.description: 紬把相册翻到两人旅行的那一页，指着拍歪的照片笑了起来。你说下次重新拍，她却把那张照片按住：“这张也很好。”
data.action: pointing at a photograph in an open album
data.promptProse: Sitting on a living-room sofa, Tsumugi points to a crooked photograph in an open album and smiles toward her partner.
data.animaCaption: She shares the album with her partner, who is outside the frame.
